description: This file defines the LinkCollection class, which manages a collection of JSON:API Link objects within the Drupal JSON:API module. It includes methods for constructing, iterating, merging, filtering, and managing context for link collections.

classes.name: LinkCollection
classes.description: A final class that manages a set of JSON:API Link objects, supporting iteration, merging, filtering, and context management within the Drupal JSON:API module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a LinkCollection with an array of links and an optional context, asserting validity of keys and link objects.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for the links, asserting that a context has been established.

methods.name: withLink
methods.description: Returns a new LinkCollection with a specified link inserted or merged if identical.

methods.name: hasLinkWithKey
methods.description: Checks if a link with the given key exists in the collection.

methods.name: withContext
methods.description: Creates a new LinkCollection with a specified context.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the current context object of the LinkCollection.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters the LinkCollection based on a callback function, returning a new filtered collection.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Static method to merge two LinkCollections into a new one, asserting they share the same context.

methods.name: validKey
methods.description: Protected static method to validate link keys, ensuring they are strings without colons or numeric values.
